parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The ID of the organization. You can obtain this ID from the URL of your organization in Alibaba Cloud DevOps, for example, `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{OrgId}`.

parameters.name: pipelineId
parameters.description: The ID of the pipeline. You can obtain this ID from the pipeline URL, for example, `https://flow.aliyun.com/pipelines/{PipelineId}/current`.

parameters.name: relObjectIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the related resources. This parameter currently accepts only the IDs of variable groups. To specify multiple IDs, separate them with a comma.

parameters.name: relObjectType
parameters.description: The type of the related resource. The only value currently supported is `VARIABLE_GROUP`, which represents a variable group.
